```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(googlesheets4)

gs4_deauth()
dsfl <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OY0UkdGDqPPGdayZBOq0qSnkE1K5Qoui7j5oMZiKsyI/edit?gid=0#gid=0")
```

```{r}
# wrangle the data from google sheets into a format that can be displayed like an actual "Facts Label"

facts <- dsfl |>
  mutate(
    field = `Data Source Facts Label`,
    value = coalesce(`...2`, `...4`)
  ) |>
  select(field, value) |>
  mutate(
    row_type = if_else(
      grepl("^[0-9]+\\.", field),
      "section",
      "item"
    ),
    value = if_else(is.na(value), "", value)
  )

# Create a spacer row to separate sections
spacer <- data.frame(
  field = "",
  value = "",
  row_type = "spacer"
)

# Identify which section each row belongs to
section_id <- cumsum(facts$row_type == "section")

# Insert spacer rows between sections
facts <- facts |>
  split(section_id) |>
  lapply(\(x) rbind(x, spacer)) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  head(-1)  # Remove the trailing spacer after the last section
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

# Note to students: Do not change this code chunk

cat("
<style>
table.nutrition-label {
  width: 75%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 2px solid black;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

table.nutrition-label th,
table.nutrition-label td {
  border: 1px solid black;
  padding: 5px 7px;
}

table.nutrition-label thead tr:nth-child(2) {
  display: none;
}
</style>
")

label_table <- facts |>
  select(field, value) |>
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("", ""),
    align = c("l", "l"),
    escape = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="nutrition-label"'
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    c("Data Source Facts Label" = 2),
    background = "black",
    color = "white",
    bold = TRUE,
    font_size =18
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    which(facts$row_type == "section"),
    background = "black",
    color = "white",
    bold = TRUE,
    font_size = 12
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    which(facts$row_type == "item"),
    bold = TRUE,
    font_size = 11
  ) |>
  row_spec(
    which(facts$row_type == "spacer"),
    extra_css = "height: 26px;"
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "50%") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "50%")

cat(as.character(label_table))
```
